# ECN-2026-014 Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Reason for change
- Field inspection discovered inconsistent ram clamping preload history on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 that increases risk of ram misalignment and accelerated wear. The corrective action standardizes the main ram bolt preload to the value required by the original equipment manufacturer verification procedure and to ensure consistent clamp load across service events.
- This change aligns maintenance execution with supplier recommendations and reduces repeat corrective repairs referenced in ECN-2026-024.

Affected items
- Primary: EQ-P1-L4-HP02 main ram bolting and adjacent clamp hardware as recorded in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.
- Secondary: Maintenance records and work instructions that reference ram fastener torque in SOP-P1-L4-03.

Implementation
- Update MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and SOP-P1-L4-03 to reflect the specified main ram bolt torque for EQ-P1-L4-HP02.
- The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m.
- Apply the updated torque value during the next scheduled maintenance task and on all subsequent corrective or preventive actions affecting the main ram bolting on EQ-P1-L4-HP02.
- Record verifications in the equipment log and update MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 per existing document control procedures.

Approvals
- Engineering: Approval required to revise MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and SOP-P1-L4-03 with the torque specification above.
- Maintenance: Acknowledgement required for change in field procedures and for training on the updated torque requirement.
- Quality: Final acceptance following verification of applied torque on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 and closure of any related nonconformances referenced in ECN-2026-024.

Related documents: ECN-2026-024, MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, SOP-P1-L4-03
